name: the-read-of-the-elision-of-a-string-answers-the-string
query: {:s "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"} | :v it | elide 60 | get /s/read | :r it | v | apply r | eq (v | get /s)

name: the-top-keeps-its-first-element-and-an-elision-of-the-rest
query: 200 | range | map ~("a") | join "" | :s it | get [~(s) ~(s)] | elide 200 | get [~(type) ~(count) ~(last | type)]

name: a-part-that-prints-most-of-the-part-around-it-gives-way-in-its-place
query: 500 | range | map ~("a") | join "" | :s it | get [~({:n 1} | put /big s) {:n 2}] | elide 200 | get [~(get /0/big | type) ~(get /0/n) ~(get /1)]

name: a-set-past-its-budget-halves-and-stands-in-the-one-order
query: 40 | range | distinct | :v it | elide 60 | :e it | get [~(e | type) ~(e | last | type) ~(e | last | get /read | :r it | v | apply r | eq (v | drop (e | count | sub 1)))]

name: the-parts-of-a-set-give-way-within-it
query: 200 | range | map ~("a") | join "" | :s it | get [~(s) ~(s | append "b")] | distinct | elide 150 | get [~(type) ~(count) ~(filter ~(type | eq ::elision) | count)]

name: a-set-under-a-tag-keeps-its-shape
query: 40 | range | distinct | tag ::Box | elide 60 | get [~(type) ~(payload | count)]

name: a-doc-gives-way-whole-with-the-head-of-its-text
query: get [~(::vec/sort | doc)] | :v it | elide 100 | get /0 | get [~(type) ~(get /size | eq (v | get /0 | content | count)) ~(get /head | type)]

name: the-read-of-the-elision-of-a-quote-answers-the-quote
query: get [~(::vec/sort | source)] | :v it | elide 100 | get /0 | get [~(type) ~(get /read | :r it | v | apply r | eq (v | get /0))]

name: an-elision-counts-a-part-that-gave-way-whole-as-one-element
query: 200 | range | map ~("a") | join "" | :s it | get [[~(s)] [1]] | elide 60 | get /0/size

name: an-elision-of-a-text-counts-and-keeps-its-characters
query: 61 | range | map ~("😀") | join "" | :s it | {} | put /s s | elide 30 | get /s | get [/size ~(get /head | count)]

name: an-elision-prints-on-one-line
query: {:s "a long line of text to leave out, which runs on long enough that its elision prints shorter than it"} | elide 40 | get /s | print | contains "\n"
